title: Connector protocol: shared definitions
description: Shared definitions of the connector protocol (docs/protocol.md). Every message is one JSON object on one line (NDJSON) with a `type`; requests and their replies are correlated by `id`.

id.description: Request id chosen by the side that initiates the request. Runtime-initiated and connector-initiated ids are separate namespaces. The handshake uses the fixed id "hello".

parent.description: Id of the runtime request (`schedule`, `run`, `describe`) in whose context a connector-initiated message was produced; null outside any request (for example at import time).

ctx.description: Per-call context. analysisId, seq, round, executionId and filesDir are null for schedule; deadlineMs is null when there is no deadline.

scanId.description: Scan id; in local mode the spec's runId (the test-run id, or "local" for `scantor dev run`).

round.description: Retry-failed round of the analysis (1 in local mode).

attempt.description: 1-based attempt of this run (schedule: scheduler start count).

deadlineMs.description: Epoch milliseconds (container clock) at which the runtime ends the call.

tmpDir.description: Absolute path of an empty, writable directory private to this call; deleted by the runtime afterwards.

filesDir.description: Absolute path of the directory where the connector places file contents before registering them with `file`.

error.description: Error object exchanged on the protocol. The runtime turns connector errors into the full ScantorError (adding phase, attempt, at, and the retryable classification).

type.description: connector → runtime: taskError, fatal, retry, validation, or cancelled (only after `cancel` or the deadline); the runtime treats any other type as taskError. runtime → connector: validation or platform.

retryable.description: Set by the runtime on runtime → connector errors (informational for user code); ignored on connector → runtime errors, whose retryability the runtime derives from the type.

delayMs.description: Only for `retry`: requested delay before the next attempt.

details.description: ≤ 4 KiB JSON object, e.g. {issues: [{path, message}]} for validation.

fileRef.description: Reference to an uploaded file; appears in results at fileRefPaths.

credit.description: Number of additional template items the connector can accept.
